content.title: Fluorescent Fight Feedback | Contact-Bound Energy and Named Finish
content.summary: An adult parkour instructor clears training drones with contact-bound cyan arcs and an original finishing-move card. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult fighter, one fixed arena axis and readable opponent lanes establish spatial truth. + Every evade, block or strike completes a physical trajectory before energy feedback begins. + Energy color, direction and duration remain consequences of verified contact. + Opponent count and proximity may escalate without changing the fighter's identity or resetting geography. + The final named move is original, follows the strongest contact and ends with a stable adult stance after all light decays.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one original adult parkour instructor with a copper braid, slate training suit and one cyan forearm guard at the center of an empty concrete ferry deck. Only after the block makes contact, release a brief cyan arc aligned to the drone's retreat; the light must not manufacture the hit. One final two-hand strike sends a circular cyan afterimage through the established lanes, then the adult holds beneath the exact original move name "TIDELINE BREAK" as all light decays.
required_anchors: One clearly adult fighter, one fixed arena axis and readable opponent lanes establish spatial truth.
Every evade, block or strike completes a physical trajectory before energy feedback begins.
Opponent count and proximity may escalate without changing the fighter's identity or resetting geography.
The final named move is original, follows the strongest contact and ends with a stable adult stance after all light decays.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult parkour instructor clears training drones with contact-bound cyan arcs and an original finishing-move card. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先在停车场建立成年武者与逐渐逼近的轮廓对手，动作轨迹和身体接触必须先成立；紫色能量只能在命中后短促反馈并逐级增强，终局以原创招式名和稳定站姿收束。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult fighter, one fixed arena axis and readable opponent lanes establish spatial truth.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult fighter, one fixed arena axis and readable opponent lanes establish spatial truth."

invariants.rule: Every evade, block or strike completes a physical trajectory before energy feedback begins.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every evade, block or strike completes a physical trajectory before energy feedback begins."

invariants.rule: Energy color, direction and duration remain consequences of verified contact.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Energy color, direction and duration remain consequences of verified contact."

invariants.rule: Opponent count and proximity may escalate without changing the fighter's identity or resetting geography.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Opponent count and proximity may escalate without changing the fighter's identity or resetting geography."

invariants.rule: The final named move is original, follows the strongest contact and ends with a stable adult stance after all light decays.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final named move is original, follows the strongest contact and ends with a stable adult stance after all light decays."

slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
